# Milwaukee Tool

> > Professional-grade power tools, hand tools, accessories, and workwear featuring M18 and M12 cordless systems with REDLITHIUM batteries and POWERSTATE brushless motors.

Milwaukee Tool manufactures innovative cordless and corded power tools, hand tools, safety equipment, and work apparel for professional tradespeople. Their product ecosystem centers on the M18 and M12 battery platforms with REDLINK Intelligence technology for optimized performance and durability.

## Key Topics

- M18 System
- M12 System
- M12 FUEL
- REDLITHIUM Batteries
- POWERSTATE Brushless Motor
- REDLINK PLUS Intelligence
- Combo Kits
- Brushless Motor Technology
- Impact Drivers & Wrenches
- Cordless Tools
- SMARTSWIPE Touchscreen
- Cut Resistant Gloves
- ANSI/ISEA Safety Standards
- Professional Workwear
